hero_eyebrow: Free to start · Runs in your browser · Nothing is uploaded
hero_lead: Cut out the parts you don't need and shrink the file size — all processed locally on your device. Nothing is ever sent to a server.
drop_title: Drop a video, or click to choose one
drop_sub: MP4, WebM, MOV — up to 500 MB
unsupported_browser: Your browser doesn't support in-browser video export. Try the latest Chrome, Edge, or Firefox.
range_too_short: Select a trim range of at least a fraction of a second.
export_error: Something went wrong during export, please try again.
footnote: Your video stays in this browser tab — nothing is uploaded or saved automatically.
how_lead: Drop a clip, pick the section you want, choose a quality level, then export.
step1_desc: Drag and drop a file, or select one from your device.
step2_desc: Drag the start and end handles to pick exactly the part you want to keep.
step3_desc: Choose high, medium, or low quality, then download the trimmed clip.
